project.title: CloudChange — IBM Db2 Integration
project.short_description: Enterprise cloud infrastructure change impact analysis and empirical post-deployment verification engine powered by IBM Db2 for durable audit logging, ACID relational persistence, and governance analytics.
project.category: Enterprise Data Engineering / Cloud Governance & Compliance

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 Community Edition (Docker) / Db2 Enterprise / Db2 on Cloud
features_used: Relational Tables with Foreign Key Cascade Constraints (ON DELETE CASCADE)
Parameterized Prepared Statements for SQL Injection Prevention
Explicit Multi-Statement ACID Transactions with Commit and Rollback
Secondary B-Tree Composite and Foreign Key Indexes for High-Throughput Queries
CLOB Document Columns for Complex Terraform Diffs and Empirical AWS Evidence
Immutable Compliance Audit Trail Event Logging (cc_audit_events)
